plan.architecture_summary: MonsoonPay's asia-south2 (Delhi) Cloud Run / Envoy proxy suffers from premature queue exhaustion (max_pending_requests=64) during festival flash sales, triggering synchronous retry storms that amplify checkout p99 latency to 430ms+. Upgrading Envoy queue depth to 512, enforcing a jittered exponential circuit breaker, and falling back to Spanner Omni Software TrueTime bounded stale reads (<15ms) isolates upstream saturation and restores sub-15ms tail latency while leveraging healthy <3ms TrueTime drift across asia-south1 (Mumbai) and asia-south2.
plan.risk_assessment: 1. Benchmark Coverage Gap: benchmark_policy only simulates up to 184 concurrent requests, so SHIPPED_SWARM_POLICY (max_envoy_pending_requests=512) never trips BreakerState.OPEN or exercises fallback_reads under test. 2. HALF_OPEN State Fragility: A single saturated probe in HALF_OPEN fails to immediately re-open the circuit unless consecutive_failures >= failure_threshold, and probe throttling is count-modulo rather than time-windowed. 3. Read/Write Semantics & Drift Resilience: Checkout mutations cannot blindly degrade to stale reads without idempotency/read-only validation, and raising an unhandled ValueError when TrueTime drift exceeds 7.0ms risks hard 500s instead of failing over to healthy asia-south1.

Add deterministic unit and stress tests simulating >600 concurrent flash-sale requests and regional TrueTime drift spikes so SHIPPED_SWARM_POLICY exercises CLOSED -> OPEN -> HALF_OPEN transitions and verifies p99 < 20ms.

Harden SpannerOmniCircuitBreaker state machine to immediately re-open on HALF_OPEN probe saturation, implement true multi-attempt jittered exponential backoff bounded by max_retries, restrict TrueTime bounded stale-read fallback to read/idempotent paths, and add graceful asia-south1 (Mumbai) regional failover when TrueTime drift exceeds 7.0ms.
